corrected_spec.data_source: Existing API Keys keys.list restrictions.apiTargets[].service and key name; new read-only Service Usage services.list name/state for the owning project. Service Usage Service.name has projects/{consumer}/services/{DNS service}, with optional config.name and parent consistency checks; all same-scope DNS names, including marketplace domains, remain in the complete inventory.
corrected_spec.description: On api key resources, detects when a key restrictions.apiTargets[].service names a project service whose Service Usage state is DISABLED; this matters because it can lead to excessive access or misuse of credentials.
corrected_spec.predicate: FAIL if a key restrictions.apiTargets[].service names a project service whose Service Usage state is DISABLED. UNKNOWN for unrestricted keys, missing service inventory or whether a key is still used; an ENABLED service does not establish active use.
corrected_spec.remediation_hint: In APIs & Services > Credentials, edit the key's API restrictions to remove disabled services; delete unused keys.
corrected_spec.title: API keys target only active enabled services

decision_boundaries: A fully resolved disabled explicit target may FAIL even with unrelated valid marketplace services.
Any absent explicit target remains UNKNOWN before disabled-target decision.
Only enabled explicit targets remain UNKNOWN because active key use is unproven.
Foreign, duplicate casefold, malformed, contradicted config/parent/alias, and incomplete inventories remain UNKNOWN.

official_references.supports: Service.name and optional Service.config.name/parent structure; states ENABLED/DISABLED.
Complete list covers visible services; an absent target has no explicit disabled state.
ApiTarget.service is a case-insensitive canonical DNS service name.
Private service visibility can vary, so absence cannot be synthesized as DISABLED.
